# Package `thaumcraft.api.potions`

[All packages](README.md)

Types: [`PotionFluxTaint`](#potionfluxtaint), [`PotionVisExhaust`](#potionvisexhaust)

## PotionFluxTaint

```java
public final class PotionFluxTaint
```

The original TC4 flux taint potion.

Forced 1.21.1 change: 1.21.1 registers its effects, so the original `Potion` subclass became a registered `MobEffect`. The native implementation is `thaumcraft.common.lib.potions.PotionFluxTaint`; this class is the public handle of that registered effect, so an add-on never has to know the native class.

<a id="potionfluxtaint-key"></a>
```java
public static final ResourceKey<MobEffect> KEY
```

The registered identity of the original flux taint effect.

<a id="potionfluxtaint-instance"></a>
```java
public static MobEffect instance()
```

The registered effect; the original static instance was this very object.

<a id="potionfluxtaint-holder"></a>
```java
public static Holder<MobEffect> holder()
```

The registered effect as a holder, for the native effect queries.
